chunks: And in another report, he said, peace be upon him and his family:
"The mention of ʿAlī, peace be upon him, is an act of worship."

key_terms.عِبَادَةٌ: an act of worship or devotion

ai.seo_question: How does the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم describe the virtue of mentioning Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith states that mentioning Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام is itself an act of worship. It highlights his spiritual rank and the devotional significance of remembering him within the Prophetic tradition.
